notes: The densest page in the widened gold set: twenty-five printed labels, a heated crossfire of one-line interjections. Two traps here. The last label reads 'Sr. Negre de Alonso' although the senator is a woman and is addressed as 'señora senadora' in the line above — a typographical error in the source, recorded verbatim. And Sanz's long speech continues past a paragraph break ('No es un capricho mío...') with no new label, so that paragraph is not a new turn.
